scope: Source-inspired profiles extracted from sixteen verified article and guideline configurations and their inspected article editions; not universal publisher standards or pixel-accurate replicas.

font_policy.cjk_serif: Noto Serif CJK SC if installed; otherwise FandolSong supplied by TeX Live
font_policy.cjk_sans: Noto Sans CJK SC if installed; otherwise FandolHei supplied by TeX Live
font_policy.adaptation: The verified Windows deliveries used SimSun/Arial/Microsoft YaHei in places. Portable Noto/Fandol and TeX Gyre substitutes deliberately replace those platform dependencies, so line breaks can differ.

cell.reference_edition: Cell 185 (2022), Atherosclerosis: Recent developments, supplied article edition
cell.citations: Blue parenthetical author-year, with internal bibliography links
cell.observed_design: Blue journal lettering, dark red Leading Edge and headings, grey Review marker; full-width title, authors, affiliation/DOI area, grey divider, blue SUMMARY text, then two columns; wide figure on left with narrow caption on right when suitable
cell.template_adaptation: Plain Cell text replaces publisher logo; no volume/date fabricated; two neutral sample pages

nature.reference_edition: Nature 592 (2021), The changing landscape of atherosclerosis, supplied article edition
nature.citations: Black numeric superscripts, with internal bibliography links
nature.observed_design: Black-and-white review design with thin outer vertical rule; full-width serif title; approximately 1:2 publication metadata and author/abstract panel below; two-column body; fine rules
nature.template_adaptation: No genuine DOI/date or publication identity used; plain Nature text in footer; metadata panel height follows neutral text rather than the full-length original abstract

science.reference_edition: Science 392 (2026), Targeting modulated vascular smooth muscle cells in atherosclerosis via FAP-directed immunotherapy, supplied article edition
science.citations: Blue italic parenthetical numbers, not superscripts; internal bibliography links
science.observed_design: Independent research summary page with red summary band, red discipline label, serif title, four summary sections and overview illustration; main article starts on next page with left-column title/authors/sans abstract/red divider, then natural two-column text; RESEARCH ARTICLE with short underline; full-width figures and compact captions
science.template_adaptation: Discipline, author names and publication details explicitly marked as placeholders; no live DOI or fabricated QR code; three pages demonstrate summary, article opening, figure/backmatter

immunity.reference_edition: Immunity (2025), Inflammation in atherosclerosis: Lessons and therapeutic implications, supplied corrected-proof edition
immunity.citations: Blue numeric superscripts, with internal bibliography links
immunity.observed_design: Cell-family blue journal heading and summary, grey Review label, dark red section hierarchy, full-width title/author/abstract area, double columns and compact full-width figure captions
immunity.template_adaptation: Plain Immunity lettering instead of logo; no proof citation box; independent Chinese page numbers and neutral placeholders

nature-reviews-cardiology.reference_edition: Nature Reviews Cardiology 21 (2024), Efferocytosis in atherosclerosis, supplied published review edition
nature-reviews-cardiology.citations: Blue numeric superscripts, with internal bibliography links
nature-reviews-cardiology.observed_design: Purple top rule; separate opening page with full-width title and authors, roughly 3:1 abstract/section-contents panels divided by a vertical rule, affiliations at the abstract foot; later two-column serif body with sans headings and ruled key points; full-width multipage table with repeated heading and column labels; blue journal name in ruled footer
nature-reviews-cardiology.template_adaptation: Four neutral pages; plain journal lettering instead of logo; separate Chinese page numbers; placeholder metadata, abstract, vector diagram, references and source information; 20 original placeholder rows demonstrate a two-page table without copying article data; 108 bp body top is a Chinese layout adaptation

nature-biotechnology.reference_edition: Nature Biotechnology 44 (June 2026), supplied Brief Communication edition published online in July 2025
nature-biotechnology.citations: Blue numeric superscripts, with internal bibliography links
nature-biotechnology.observed_design: Yellow top rule on opening page only; plain journal-name substitute; manuscript type at left and DOI at right above a fine rule; full-width serif title; approximately 1:2 date and author/abstract panels; two-column body on the opening page; compact sans captions and blue ruled footer
nature-biotechnology.template_adaptation: Three neutral pages: opening and numbered equations, full-width original vector diagram and body, reporting-field table and source information. Fonts use common.tex fallbacks. Affiliations follow the abstract rather than sitting at the original page foot. Equations and ten reporting rows are demonstration material, not source research or required journal fields. The 58 bp body top and pagination are Chinese adaptations.
nature-biotechnology.version_handling: Keep online publication date, issue date and copyright year as distinct source fields; do not infer one from another.

nature-methods.reference_edition: Nature Methods, supplied 2026 Perspective and supplied Analysis edition with unfilled online-publication date
nature-methods.citations: Blue numeric superscripts, with internal bibliography links
nature-methods.observed_design: Orange top rule on opening page only; journal name above manuscript-type/DOI line; full-width serif title; approximately 1:2 dates and author/abstract panels; body begins in two columns on same page; full-width tables, independent grey-backed box text, figures and compact sans captions; ruled running heads and feet
nature-methods.template_adaptation: Three original neutral pages showing opening, two-column text, a full-width Chinese table and grey box, original vector figure and complete caption, bibliography, declarations and ending source information. Plain journal lettering replaces the logo. Continuous columns use multicol so full-width modules can interrupt the body. Body top, fonts and pagination are Chinese adaptations. No source article authors, DOI, text, figures or real data.
nature-methods.version_handling: Do not infer online publication dates, year, issue, volume or page ranges from filenames, DOI years or acceptance dates when absent from the supplied edition.

circulation.reference_edition: Circulation, supplied published 2025 Original Research Article edition
circulation.citations: Black numeric superscripts, with internal bibliography links
circulation.observed_design: Green research-type label and rule; full-width sans title/authors and structured abstract with red labels, conclusions may continue on the next page; independent red clinical-perspective and abbreviation boxes beside body; full-width figures with red caption labels
circulation.template_adaptation: Three neutral pages showing structured abstract, clinical-perspective/abbreviation boxes, two-column body, original vector figure, complete caption, linked placeholder references, declarations and ending source information. Plain journal lettering replaces the logo; official side tabs and update badges are omitted. Body size, baseline, margins and pagination are Chinese adaptations. All abbreviations are original layout placeholders, not medical terminology. No source authors, DOI, text, data or figures.
circulation.version_handling: Record both article number and printed page range when present; preserve explicit publication dates rather than inferring from the DOI or filename.
circulation.color_provenance: Exact RGB values read from text spans in the supplied source PDF; shared only as journal layout parameters.
circulation.figure_placement: Place each main figure near its first substantive discussion in the body, preserving the source reading sequence. Do not collect all main figures at the end of the article; all main figures must precede the bibliography. Pagination may change for Chinese length.

circulation-research.reference_edition: Circulation Research, supplied published 2026 Review edition
circulation-research.citations: Black numeric superscripts, with internal bibliography links
circulation-research.observed_design: Blue review-type label and rule; full-width sans title/authors and unstructured abstract, keywords and grey rule before two-column body on the same page; extended abbreviation boxes across columns; blue sans headings and full-width figure captions
circulation-research.template_adaptation: Three neutral pages showing same-page abstract/body opening, an extended abbreviation box, two-column text, original vector figure, complete caption, linked placeholder references, declarations and ending source information. Plain journal lettering replaces the logo; official side tabs and update badges are omitted. Body size, baseline, margins and pagination are Chinese adaptations. All abbreviations are original layout placeholders, not medical terminology. No source authors, DOI, text, data or figures.
circulation-research.version_handling: Record both article number and printed page range when present; preserve explicit publication dates rather than inferring from the DOI or filename.
circulation-research.color_provenance: Exact RGB values read from text spans in the supplied source PDF; shared only as journal layout parameters.
circulation-research.figure_placement: Place each main figure near its first substantive discussion in the body, preserving the source reading sequence. Do not collect all main figures at the end of the article; all main figures must precede the bibliography. Pagination may change for Chinese length.

european-heart-journal.reference_edition: European Heart Journal, supplied 2023 advance-article Translational Research edition
european-heart-journal.source_font_and_hierarchy: Gill Sans Nova; bold title 23/28 bp, bold authors 13/16 bp, main headings red bold 15 bp, subheadings black bold 12.5 bp, body 9 bp.
european-heart-journal.citations: Black numeric superscripts with internal bibliography links; external URLs blue
european-heart-journal.color_provenance: Theme from source PDF text spans and panel colors from drawing objects; shared only as reusable layout parameters.
european-heart-journal.observed_design: Red translational-research label and rule; full-width bold title/authors, affiliations and dates; pale-beige structured abstract with narrow label and wide text columns and dotted separators; separate structured graphical abstract with three question/finding/message blocks, figure, caption, keywords and grey translational-perspective box; later two-column sans body with integrated full-width figures and captions.
european-heart-journal.template_adaptation: Three neutral pages; ordinary journal name replaces ESC branding; TeX Gyre Heros plus Noto/Fandol sans substitutes for commercial Gill Sans Nova. Body size, baseline, page breaks and title length are Chinese adaptations. Pale panels stay within the text block rather than bleeding to page edges. Short demo panels use minipages; real long panels/captions require a breakable layout and fresh rendering. All text and TikZ diagrams are original neutral placeholders, with no real source authors, DOI, data or figures.
european-heart-journal.figure_placement: Interleave main figures near their first substantive discussion and follow source order. Smaller full-width figures may share a page with two-column prose above or below. Do not collect all figures at the end; all main figures precede the bibliography.
european-heart-journal.version_handling: Retain supplied advance-article year, provisional volume/page fields and explicit dates. Do not silently replace them with later issue metadata or infer missing publication dates.

circulation-guideline.template_adaptation: Three original neutral pages: full-width committee opening, two-column prose and recommendation-color table, original vector figure and compact caption, linked placeholder references, declarations and ending source information. Commercial journal fonts are replaced by portable TeX Gyre and Noto/Fandol fonts. The Chinese body, 7.6/9.2bp captions and demonstration page breaks are adaptations. No source authors, real clinical recommendations, thresholds, figures, DOI or download information.
circulation-guideline.figure_placement: Interleave figures with the continuing source-order prose. Measure the combined height of figures, complete captions and surrounding text; use adjacent continuation captions when needed rather than collecting figures at the end or forcing short text pages.
circulation-guideline.content_reuse: Retain verified prose, recommendation codes and bibliography; record and compare content fingerprints. A typography change must not change the recommendation system, negation, conditions or scientific content.
circulation-guideline.reference_edition: Circulation, supplied 2022 and 2026 clinical-practice guideline editions
circulation-guideline.source_font_and_hierarchy: Akzidenz Grotesk; light title about24.67bp, body10bp, red main headings about12.33bp, source captions8bp.
circulation-guideline.observed_design: Red clinical-practice guideline banner and line, light black full-width title, endorsed-organizations and writing-committee lists. Structured abstract can begin on the 2022 first page but follows the longer 2026 committee opening. Two-column sans body with red headings and separate COR/LOE columns; distinct no-benefit and harm categories.
circulation-guideline.citations: Retain source numeric conventions and knowledge-unit bibliography resets. Use section plus number for targets rather than treating repeated numbers as globally unique.
circulation-guideline.recommendation_system: ACC/AHA: COR1/2a/2b/3(no benefit)/3(harm); LOE A/B-R/B-NR/C-LD/C-EO. Do not convert to ESC classes.
circulation-guideline.color_provenance: Header RGB from source text spans; recommendation colors from source drawing objects. Neutral table uses rounded colors and simplified evidence shades.
circulation-guideline.palette_version_handling: The default neutral preview follows2026 fills. Define GuideEditionTwentyTwo before loading circulation-guideline.tex to select the observed2022 COR/B-level palette. The two editions do not share identical recommendation colors; verify each source. Neutral C-level shades and placeholder harm row remain schematic.

european-heart-journal-guideline.template_adaptation: Three original neutral pages: full-width committee opening, two-column prose and recommendation-color table, original vector figure and compact caption, linked placeholder references, declarations and ending source information. Commercial journal fonts are replaced by portable TeX Gyre and Noto/Fandol fonts. The Chinese body, 7.6/9.2bp captions and demonstration page breaks are adaptations. No source authors, real clinical recommendations, thresholds, figures, DOI or download information.
european-heart-journal-guideline.figure_placement: Interleave figures with the continuing source-order prose. Measure the combined height of figures, complete captions and surrounding text; use adjacent continuation captions when needed rather than collecting figures at the end or forcing short text pages.
european-heart-journal-guideline.content_reuse: Retain verified prose, recommendation codes and bibliography; record and compare content fingerprints. A typography change must not change the recommendation system, negation, conditions or scientific content.
european-heart-journal-guideline.reference_edition: European Heart Journal, supplied2024 ESC guideline edition
european-heart-journal-guideline.source_font_and_hierarchy: Gill Sans Nova; body8.5bp, bold black title, dark-red main headings and recommendation headings.
european-heart-journal-guideline.color_provenance: Theme from source text spans, recommendation fills from source drawing objects. The neutral demo simplifies evidence shades.
european-heart-journal-guideline.observed_design: Red ESC GUIDELINES label and line, full-width bold black title, task-force and endorsed-organization information, two-column sans body. Recommendation content precedes separate Class and LOE columns. No translational-research beige structured abstract or separate graphical-summary page.
european-heart-journal-guideline.citations: Source numeric superscripts with corresponding English bibliography targets.
european-heart-journal-guideline.recommendation_system: ESC classes I/IIa/IIb/III and levels A/B/C, preserved independently of ACC/AHA codes.

nejm.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine

source_observations.source_version_note: Online publication version may omit final volume, issue and page range. Use only supplied version metadata.
source_observations.source_running_header: Even: red journal name; odd: black short article title. Cover journal name centered over narrow main column.

chinese_adaptation.fonts: shared common.tex CJK fallback + TeX Gyre Termes/Heros
chinese_adaptation.cover: red text journal heading, double-edged cream article-type bar, cream abstract bar, gray authors, narrow right metadata
chinese_adaptation.figures: original neutral TikZ diagram; full-width beige caption, interleaved with prose
chinese_adaptation.table: thin black rules, red table number, serif text
chinese_adaptation.source_info: independent final section with full bibliographic placeholders
chinese_adaptation.running_header: Even red journal name; odd black short title; cover journal heading aligned to narrow main column center x230; plain text only, no official logo.

nejm.template_scope: Nonofficial, source-inspired neutral template; no official logo and no real article content/data/images/DOI/download metadata.
nejm.copyright_notice: 仅供学术交流、出版物版权归原作者及出版商所有

verification.fontspec_note: Bundled Fandol fonts report an unavailable OpenType CJK script tag. Glyph rendering is complete; this is not a missing-character warning.

nejm.reference_edition: Inspected 2026 early-online research article; final volume/issue/page range absent from supplied version
nejm.citations: Black numeric superscripts linked to bibliography
nejm.observed_design: red text journal heading, double-edged cream article-type bar, cream abstract bar, gray authors, narrow right metadata
nejm.template_adaptation: Three neutral pages; commercial fonts replaced; main Chinese body widened relative to source, while cover preserves narrow main column and right metadata; source geometry and adaptation recorded separately.

lancet.reference_edition: Inspected 2023 Therapeutic Review online edition; final volume/issue/pagination not supplied
lancet.color_provenance: Theme and ink measured from source text/drawings; neutral panel is a simplified adaptation.
lancet.source_font_and_hierarchy: ScalaLancetPro serif body 9bp; Shaker sans title 18bp and 7/6.5bp figure captions/affiliations. Neutral template replaces commercial fonts with TeX Gyre and Noto/Fandol CJK fonts.
lancet.observed_design: Alternating outer-edge green tab; Therapeutic Review category; green horizontal rule near y102bp. Black sans title, small green author line, bold serif opening abstract, first-page narrow affiliation sidebar, two-column serif prose, green main section headings, compact sans captions and tabular fields, pale green search-strategy panel.
lancet.template_adaptation: Three original neutral pages: opening with sidebar/abstract/search panel; vector diagram/table interleaved with prose; discussion/declarations/placeholder references and ending source information. No real article content, authors, DOI, original figures, publisher logo or download data.
lancet.citations: Source numeric superscript convention; preserve English bibliography and verify targets.
lancet.figure_placement: Interleave source-order prose and figures; measure complete caption plus image. Do not collect large figures at the end or create short text pages by forcing an oversized block. Preserve exact panel limits; purge cropped-out source streams.
lancet.content_reuse: Reuse previously verified translations for a typography-only change, keeping content fingerprints and all references; verify source edition and marked uncertainties independently.

jama.variant: Original Investigation / Randomized Clinical Trial; corrected issue reprint supplied by user

portable_fonts.cjk_serif: Noto Serif CJK SC or FandolSong
portable_fonts.cjk_sans: Noto Sans CJK SC or FandolHei

structure: wide beige structured abstract with narrow related-resource sidebar
editable Chinese tables with beige row bands
original scientific figure beside compact caption
jama.adaptation_notes: Key Points may span both columns for Chinese readability. The deep-red Research banner is distinct from the brighter accent red. Chinese body and captions are optically enlarged. Figures should float near first discussion; avoid fixed page breaks that strand short text above a tall figure. All real-paper fields must come from the supplied source, including issue, online and correction dates.
jama.scope: Neutral3-page demonstrated layout; no real paper content, authors, DOI, scientific data, publisher logos or download information. Not a universal official JAMA template.
jama.copyright: 仅供学术交流、出版物版权归原作者及出版商所有
jama.reference_edition: Inspected corrected 2026 issue reprint of a 2025 online randomized clinical trial; issue, online and correction dates are separate source fields
jama.citations: Black numeric superscripts linked to bibliography
jama.observed_design: Research deep-red banner; JAMA and red article type; title and authors; wide beige structured abstract with narrow related-resource sidebar; Key Points; two-column main text; editable Chinese tables with beige row bands; original scientific figure beside compact caption; article information; black superscript internally linked citations; complete bibliography; source information at end
jama.template_adaptation: Key Points may span both columns for Chinese readability. The deep-red Research banner is distinct from the brighter accent red. Chinese body and captions are optically enlarged. Figures should float near first discussion; avoid fixed page breaks that strand short text above a tall figure. All real-paper fields must come from the supplied source, including issue, online and correction dates.

bmj.reference_edition: Inspected 2022 Research article with structured abstract and network-meta-analysis tables
bmj.source_font_and_hierarchy: Source MetaSerifProBook body 8.7bp, MetaHeadline title 17bp, MetaPro sans labels; portable Chinese substitution uses TeX Gyre and Noto/Fandol.
bmj.observed_design: Blue RESEARCH band; title/authors and two-column structured abstract to right of narrow metadata; known/new blue box extends left into gutter; later serif double columns retain broad outer-left gutter; full-width tables and small forest plots with complete captions; black numeric superscripts.
bmj.template_adaptation: Three original neutral pages; common.tex/sample-body.tex dependencies; no real article, authors, DOI, data, figures, logo or download information. Body and captions adapted for Chinese; no requirement to reproduce source pagination.
bmj.citations: Black numeric superscripts linked to bibliography
bmj.table_policy: Preserve every comparison, risk category, absolute effect, interval direction, evidence grade and footnote. If converting fewer/more to signed differences, explicitly explain signs; shared estimates repeated by row must be identified as repeated displays.
bmj.edition_policy: DOI year and filename need not be publication year. Preserve accepted, first-published, issue and correction dates independently when supplied.

shared_demo_content: Original neutral prose and a newly drawn TikZ placeholder diagram. No copied article prose, figures, journal logos, patient counts, fixed real DOI, institution/IP/date download overlays, or claimed scientific results.
required_customization: Preserve source content and citation conventions
Compile twice and render every page
Confirm no missing glyphs, overflow, missing reference targets, or caption loss
